$comment: What a full run of e2e/configured/ must show, read by scripts/configured-verdict.mjs for BOTH workflows that run it: configured-suite.yml (local stack) and hosted-latency.yml (hosted staging). One file, so the two cannot drift. minTests is the number of tests that run: 82 ran on main on 2026-10-08 (configured-suite run 37795143698), plus the per-graphic replacement walk, the two community pack tests added with migration 0080, and the two publish guard tests. Raise it in the change that adds a test or brings a skipped one back, and lower it deliberately in the one that removes a test. An entry in allowedSkips is coverage given up, so it needs its reason; take a file off in the change that makes it run again.

allowedSkips.bridge-real-server.spec.ts: Drives a real NoaCG Bridge and a real CasparCG behind BRIDGE_REAL=1. A runner has neither, so its tests can only skip (issue #371).
